meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需切换至深度工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望用一个模式指令来引导工作状态
copy.tagline_en: Switch into a deep work mode on demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a directive to steer your working state

howto.what: 你请求进入 ultrawork 模式后,Claude 先显示固定的“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”提示行,然后按流程作业:先定目标、验收标准与任务清单,测试先红后绿,亲手经真实通道验证并留存证据后,才宣告完成。
howto.when: 当你说“进入/启用 ultrawork 模式”等请求,且本段对话中还没载入该指令时,即会触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,修登录接口的 bug。
say.note: 先显示固定的启动行,再进入执行流程。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式给项目加支付回调。
say.note: 支付回调属外部集成,会按重型流程验证。

say.text: 这是数据库迁移,进 ultrawork 模式,先写失败用例。
say.note: 数据库结构变更属重型,会先红后绿并覆盖边界场景。

howto.what_en: When requested, Claude enters ultrawork mode: prints an enable line, records the goal with success criteria and a task list, writes failing-first tests, verifies through real channels and keeps captured evidence before reporting done.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks to enter or enable ultrawork mode in the conversation and the directive is not already loaded.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix the bug in the login endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude prints the fixed enable line first, then starts.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to add a payment callback to the project.
say_en.note: Payment integrations are verified under the heavy tier.

say_en.text: This is a DB migration - use ultrawork mode and write failing tests first.
say_en.note: DB changes are heavy tier: red-first proof plus edge QA.
